auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T1.phone
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
INNER JOIN EventDetails AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id
WHERE T3.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
